title: An error caused by the end of the input is positioned at the end of the input
notes: Every character is acceptable, but the flow sequence is never closed. No character is at fault, so the position is the point just after the last character: the line after the final line break, column 1. Positions are 1-based lines and columns counted in characters of the decoded text; the position of an error is the first character that cannot belong to any valid document (docs/case-format.md).
